text.en: Pet owners strongly praise the veterinarians and technicians at CompleteCare Veterinary Center for their dedication and bedside manner. Clients highlight Dr. Rodriguez, Dr. Lucas, and Dr. Sam for their patience, clinical knowledge, and genuine warmth across routine and complex visits. Although one client reported rude treatment from reception, the vast majority of families praise the clinical team.

title.en: Clear clinical guidance with occasional friction

text.en: Several clients appreciate the clear communication and guidance offered by veterinarians, noting thorough answers to questions and compassionate bedside manner during challenging medical conditions. Reviewers also value the team's bilingual support in English and Spanish. However, one dissatisfied owner felt front desk staff were dismissive when questioned about treatment details and charges.

title.en: Caring pet handling alongside client concerns

text.en: Most pet parents emphasize that the clinic treats animals with great kindness, noting that dogs and cats feel comfortable and well cared for. Longterm clients credit the team with helping senior cats survive chronic kidney disease and FIP through careful monitoring. One reviewer, however, questioned the clinic's genuine concern for animals after a frustrating financial dispute.

q.en: Does CompleteCare Veterinary Center offer Spanish-language consultations?

a.en: Yes, staff members at the clinic are bilingual in English and Spanish, facilitating clear communication for pet owners.

q.en: Can the clinic accommodate last-minute or urgent appointments?

a.en: Reviewers mention that the clinic was able to accommodate urgent same-day appointments when their regular vet was unavailable.

q.en: Does the facility provide on-site pharmacy services?

a.en: Yes, CompleteCare Veterinary Center has an on-site pharmacy and supports prescription orders through an online pharmacy.
The veterinary center is located at 1293 Clove Road on Staten Island.
